endpoints.title: Fetch Capture State
endpoints.description: Whether clips are on or a recording runs in this voice room, who is included, and what you and the server may still do this month.

endpoints.title: Share Clip
endpoints.description: Share a clip of the voice room you are in. Upload the audio first (tag `attachments`), then name it here with the people whose voice is in it: every one of them must be included right now. Clips must be on in the room. The clip is posted as your message in the room's chat or in another channel of the same server.

endpoints.title: Switch Clips
endpoints.description: Turn clips on or off in a voice room you are in (needs Manage Channel). Everyone who sees the room is told.

endpoints.title: Set Capture Consent
endpoints.description: Choose whether your voice may be in clips and in the recording of the voice room you are in. You can change it at any moment; it holds until you leave the room.

endpoints.title: List Clips and Episodes
endpoints.description: The clips and episodes made in this voice room, newest first.

endpoints.title: Delete Clip or Episode
endpoints.description: Remove a clip or an episode with its message and its file. Whoever saved it, everyone whose voice is in it, and people with Manage Messages in the room can.

endpoints.title: Stop Recording
endpoints.description: End the recording without saving it. The person who started it or anyone with Manage Channel can.

endpoints.title: Start Recording
endpoints.description: Start recording the voice room you are in as an episode (needs Manage Channel). Everyone who sees the room is told; a voice is included only by its owner's choice. The server needs recording time left this month (by its Wings level).

endpoints.title: Finish Recording
endpoints.description: End the recording you started and save it as an episode. Upload the audio first (tag `attachments`), then name it here with everyone whose voice is in it: each of them must have been included while it ran. The episode is posted as your message in the room's chat.

endpoints.title: Stop Ring
endpoints.description:
Stops ringing a specific user in a DM or group call.

The person being rung may stop their own ring (decline) without being in the call. Stopping anyone else's ring needs you to be in the call (NotConnected otherwise). Only valid in DM/Group channels, returns NoEffect in servers. Returns NotFound if the user is not in the DM/group. Everyone in the channel gets `VoiceRingEnd`; the person's call notification is replaced.

verification.test: voice: a bot gets a LiveKit ticket; force_disconnect is refused

endpoints.title: Join Call
endpoints.description: Asks the voice server for a token to join the call.
restrictions: Bots get IsBot when force_disconnect == Some(true).
The ticket only lets the bot connect to LiveKit; VoiceChannelJoin is sent once it actually joins the room. Bots cannot use force_disconnect.

verification.test: voice: a bot gets a LiveKit ticket; force_disconnect is refused

endpoints.title: Change a Room
endpoints.description: Locks, hides or hands over a temporary room. Locked: only the people let in (`PUT /channels/{target}/room/guests/{member}`) can join; hidden: only they can see it. People already in the room stay. `owner` hands the room to someone who is in it. For the member the room was made for, or someone who manages permissions in it.

endpoints.title: Take Someone off a Room's Guests
endpoints.description: Takes back what `PUT /channels/{target}/room/guests/{member}` gave. The member stays in the room if they are in it.

endpoints.title: Let Someone into a Room
endpoints.description: Lets a member of the server see and join a temporary room while it is locked or hidden (at most 25 people).

endpoints.title: Make a Room
endpoints.description:
Asks a room maker (a voice channel with `voice.maker`) for a voice channel of your own. The room is put right after the room maker, with the same permissions and user limit, and carries your name; you can rename it, set its user limit and remove it. It is removed when the last person leaves it, or after a minute if nobody joins it.

A member has one room per server: asking again returns it. Needs Connect in the room maker. Not for bots. Join the returned channel as any other voice channel.

endpoints.title: Play Sound
endpoints.description: Play a sound of this server into the voice channel you are in. Needs Use Soundboard and Speak there, and not being server-muted; on a stage only speakers play sounds. Limited to a few sounds every ten seconds.

endpoints.title: End Stage
endpoints.description: Closes the stage: everyone leaves the call and the topic, speakers and raised hands are cleared. Needs Mute Members and Move Members.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Log-Reason
parameters.description: Reason for action which is stored in the audit log.

endpoints.title: Fetch Stage
endpoints.description: Topic, speakers and raised hands of a stage channel.

endpoints.title: Edit Stage
endpoints.description: Set or clear the topic of a stage (needs Mute Members).

endpoints.title: Raise Hand
endpoints.description: Ask to speak on a stage you are listening to (once every 20 seconds).

endpoints.title: Lower Hand
endpoints.description: Lower your own raised hand, or (with Mute Members) someone else's.

endpoints.title: Move To Audience
endpoints.description: Stop speaking yourself, or (with Mute Members and a higher rank) send a speaker back to the listeners. When the voice server can't be told, the speaker is taken out of the call rather than left able to talk.

endpoints.title: Invite To Speak
endpoints.description: Give someone in the stage the floor (needs Mute Members, and a higher rank than theirs). Their raised hand goes down.

endpoints.title: Send Stream Preview
endpoints.description: Replace the preview of your screen share in this voice channel (a JPEG or WebP of at most 20 KB, base64). Only while you share your screen there; a new one is taken at most every 25 seconds (`NoEffect` before that).

endpoints.title: Fetch Stream Preview
endpoints.description: The latest still of someone's screen share in a voice channel you can see.

endpoints.title: Update Own Voice State
endpoints.description:
Tell the others in the voice channel that you muted or unmuted your microphone, or deafened or undeafened yourself. The voice server does not report a mute (only a track that stops), so people looking at the channel from outside the call would otherwise never see it.

This is how you are shown, nothing more: whether you can be heard is still decided by your permissions on the voice server. You must be in the call (NotConnected otherwise).
